learning_outcomes.text: Scope a policy knowledge assistant and define its answerable boundary
Organise SharePoint policy sources so answers are grounded and current
Use Claude to answer from retrieved policy text with citations, not memory
Surface the assistant in Microsoft Teams with safe interaction patterns
Operate the assistant with review, freshness and access governance

integrative_case: HR launches a Teams assistant answering from SharePoint policies: scope what it may answer, organise grounded and current sources, make Claude cite the exact clause, deliver it safely in Teams, and operate it with review and access controls.
